SPIREOFFACTORIO-ROCKET_FUEL.title: Rocket Fuel
SPIREOFFACTORIO-ROCKET_FUEL.description: Whenever you play a card that costs {energyPrefix:energyIcons(3)} or more, increase the counter on this relic. At the start of your turn gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} equal to half the number of stacks on this relic. Resets at the end of combat.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-ROCKET_FUEL.flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
SPIREOFFACTORIO-PORTABLE_FISSION_REACTOR: All power cards no longer cost {Energy:energyIcons()}, lose [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] at the start of combat.
[red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
SPIREOFFACTORIO-PORTABLE_ENERGY_SHIELD.d: At the start of non-boss combat, gain [blue]{ArtifactStart}[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold]. If you end a turn with more than [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold], gain [blue]{ArtifactGain}[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold]

SPIREOFFACTORIO-EFFICIENCY_MODULE.title: Efficiency Module
SPIREOFFACTORIO-EFFICIENCY_MODULE.descri: Reduce the {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, {Stars:starIcons()}, and {Scrap:scrapIcons()} cost of all non X cards that cost at least {energyPrefix:energyIcons(2)} by one for the first [blue]{EfficiencyModuleCardsPlayed}[/blue] cards played each turn.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-EFFICIENCY_MODULE.flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
SPIREOFFACTORIO-SPEED_MODULE.title: Speed Module
SPIREOFFACTORIO-SPEED_MODULE.description: Store the first card you play each turn on the relic. Each additional card played adds one to the relic counter. At the start of your next turn re-add the saved card to your hand with an increased {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} cost, but replay equal to the counter on the relic, then reset the counter.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-SPEED_MODULE.flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
SPIREOFFACTORIO-BIOFLUX.title: Bioflux
SPIREOFFACTORIO-BIOFLUX.description: At the start of combat, heal [green]{Heal1}[/green] HP. If your HP at the end of combat is lower than when you entered the room, heal an additional [green]{Heal2}[/green] HP.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-BIOFLUX.flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
SPIREOFFACTORIO-PRODUCTIVITY_MODULE.desc: Whenever you play a card, all copies of the same card in your hand that cost at least {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} have their cost reduced by {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for that turn, but their attack and block values are reduced by 20%.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-PRODUCTIVITY_MODULE.flav: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
SPIREOFFACTORIO-UTILITY_SCIENCE_PACK.des: Whenever you draw a [gold]Status[/gold] card, it transforms into [gold]{Cards:plural:Complex Recipe|Complex Recipes}[/gold].

SPIREOFFACTORIO-RECYCLER.title: Recycler
SPIREOFFACTORIO-RECYCLER.description: Whenever you discard a card, increase the counter on this relic. At [blue]{Recycle}[/blue] stacks, the next discarded card will be upgraded and re-added to your hand. The stack count on the relic will then reset.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-RECYCLER.flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]

SPIREOFFACTORIO-SCRAP_SHIELD.title: Scrap Shield

SPIREOFFACTORIO-PLASMA_FUEL.title: Plasma Fuel
